'''''Blade of Dorin''''' was a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] used by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in service to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was named after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was from, [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:BladeOfDorin-TCWIV.png|thumb|left|180px|The ''Blade of Dorin'' docked with a [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|hyperspace ring]]]]
The ''Blade of Dorin'' was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]].<ref name="CNDC">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961cd20f84011ce7a789390007|text=Dataclip: Shadow of ''Malevolence''|na=video file}}</ref> Named after [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], Koon's home [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was customized similarly to Anakin's ''[[Azure Angel]]'', with [[Color/Legends|blue]] and white markings to camouflage it against a blue sky. Koon's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R7-D4/Legends|R7-D4]], could fit in a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Astromech socket/Legends|socket]] located just forward of the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="SOM-D">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''|d=y}}</ref>

==History==
===''Malevolence'' crisis===
The ''Blade of Dorin'' was gifted to Jedi Master Plo Koon by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] at some point during the ''Malevolence'' crisis, after Koon lost his [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] during the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]] against the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="EpGuide201">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}}</ref> Koon and [[R7-D4/Legends|R7-D4]] flew the ''Blade of Dorin'' through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] to outpace the ''Malevolence'' to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]].<ref name="SOM">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

===First Battle of Felucia===
[[File:Plo_Koon_piloting.png|thumb|left|180px|Plo Koon flying the ''Blade of Dorin'']]
He later used the starfighter during a [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|battle]] at [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. Ordering his wingman, [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Warthog/Legends|Warthog]], to protect the gunships, General Koon initiated an attack run on the approaching [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] starfighters, clearing the way for the rest of the ships. Though the fighters made it past the blockade, they were pursued by a pair of droid starfighters into the atmosphere of Felucia. Warthog came under fire from the two Vulture droids, and Koon adjusted his course to assist the pilot.

===Battle of Kadavo===
Koon piloted the starfighter during the [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|Battle of Kadavo]], leading a squadron of [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|Clone Z-95 starfighters]]. Koon attempted to take out the turrets preventing the cruiser from landing, but they were ray shielded. Two [[HH-87 Starhopper/Legends|Zygerrian starfighters]] were pursuing Koon and two other fighters. Unable to shake them off, [[R7-D4/Legends|Koon's astromech]] cut the engines and spun backwards until he was behind them and shot them down.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Blade_of_dorin.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Blade of Dorin'' as it enters the Kaliida Nebula]]
A toy of Plo Koon's Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor was released as a part of [[Hasbro]]'s 2010 toy line in August.

[[The LEGO Group]] made a "Plo Koon's Jedi Starfighter" set, numbered 8093, that was released in [[July]] [[2010]].

The supplementary information on [[Cartoon Network]]'s [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] site, however, first published the name of the vessel, identifying it as the ''Blade of Dorin''.<ref name="CNDC" />
